notes.title: Aeon Drive Update #3: Major overhaul to player mobility + bug fixes
notes.notes:
We meet again, Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring several [b]bug fixes[/b] and improvements to the [b]mobility[/b] and [b]responsiveness[/b]. This patch was created with the help of our speedrunning community feedback, so the game should feel and play better than ever!


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Time will no longer stop when pausing on respawn
[*] Jack will no longer face a different direction when attacking/throwing dagger while idle
[*] Levels beat using wall glitches will no longer count towards the leaderboards
[*] Fixed landing animation delay and input bug
[*] Fixed bug that prevented players from teleporting to the dagger while slashing
[*] Added input buffers
[*] Ground pound animation can now be canceled
[*] Wall jump is improved and should feel more responsive now
[*] Grabbing a diamond while in co-op mode will now correctly show in the level report
[*] Fixed bug that would show all save slots with 100% collectibles unlocked
[*] Fixed end of tutorial game crash
[*] Added button remap localization
[*] Overall polish of animations and inputs
[/list]

notes.title: Aeon Drive's Development History
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
September 30th will see the release of Aeon Drive, our 2D cyberpunk action platformer.

For this occasion, we decided to guide you down the memory lane and show the growing pains the project went through.

Some may think that Aeon Drive’s aesthetic was all planned out from the beginning, being such an integral part of the game. However, as with many projects of this scale, this wasn’t the case, and the game went through a number of iterations first.

[b]R3 (Run, Rewind, Repeat!)[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eFtj43Y.gif[/img]

This is one of the earliest forms of our initial concept, showcased at GDC and PAX back in 2019. As you can see, we went for a more realistic art style, a far cry from Aeon Drive’s crunchy pixel-y cyberpunk goodness. Still, we already had some elements pinned down: the game has you play as a droid, which would eventually evolve into VERA (now who’s the sidekick?). It’s still a timed platformer and the blockly level design and overall scale of the game are what we’d stick with for the remainder of our development cycle. However, at this stage the game was obviously much slower and more sluggish; it needed that extra spark, which led us to develop it further.

[b]Project R[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g1NFEq6.gif[/img]

It was at this stage when we settled on the general pixel aesthetic and the cyberpunk mood, but it still wasn’t really Aeon Drive. The timer wasn’t nearly as punishing, as collecting in-game currency was more of a focus. The game was still quite slow, and the overall mood was much more dark and gritty than what we’d end up with. Still, we were already set on our general style, the game taking place in Neo Barcelona, a female protagonist, and even implemented some recognizable visual elements, such as the Exit sign.

[b]Aeon Drive’s GDC Build[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k7zrZnk.gif[/img]

At this point, Jackelyne’s design was much closer to the final version, the visuals were given more pop, and the soundtrack already included familiar tunes. We’ve also implemented the dagger mechanic, although it was still underbaked. It was a neat gimmick, but wasn’t fast and snappy enough yet to become a backbone for a speedrun action platformer. The time capsule mechanic was also a bit more complex: the player had to collect in-game currency which would then be exchanged for time-capsules. As you know, in the end we settled for a more direct approach.

[b]Aeon Drive’s Alpha Reveal Trailer[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gvONkk9.gif[/img]

This build of the game was unveiled at the start of 2020. At this stage, the game finally took onto its finalized look and feel. The only missing component was… Jackelyne herself. She still retained her slower movement, and that floating dagger probably wouldn’t even cut a chunk of butter if you threw it at one. In the course of that year, we did our best to completely redesign Jackelyne to make her fit into the world of Aeon Drive, gave her more movement options, toiled at some detailed sprite work, and sped everything up a notch. It was the final piece of the puzzle that made everything click into place.

Did we do a good job? That’s what you’re going to find out once Aeon Drive releases on September 30th! And for now you can check out IGN's first exclusive look at the game, where you can clearly see the fruits of our labor. See you soon!

notes.title: Aeon Drive Art Showcase
notes.notes:
Hey there, speed demons! 

We all know Aeon Drive as an extremely fast-paced game; after all, you’ve only got 30 seconds. However, it’s not like we just slapped the levels together because you wouldn’t be fast enough to process them anyway. Our team wanted to make the world of Aeon Drive feel alive, so we imbued it with fun little details here and there.

So we just want you to stay still for a bit and appreciate the little things this time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vgLUJ1Y.gif[/img]
[i]Seems like Jack found a nice secluded spot, but there is no time to rest.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OCTHtWc.gif[/img]
[i]Some things even react when you approach![/i]

Of course, each area has its own little quirks. We hope you have fun discovering all of them, along with some easter eggs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxfa4Gu.gif[/img]
[i]It’s a shame Jack has no time for a drink. Note the background layers![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qx036vi.gif[/img]
[i]You may not notice it at first, but we even have some subtle dynamic lighting.[/i]

This was just a small sample, but we hope you get to enjoy the game’s atmosphere in-between your speedrun sessions. See you on September 30th!

[url=https://discord.gg/KfmhGnfe][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/4294d235e24333c1304b29792b51fdf560a0023a.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Inspiration behind the world of Aeon Drive
notes.notes:
As some of you may know, Aeon Drive takes place in a city called Neo Barcelona, which — surprise, surprise! — is inspired by the real thing.
The name of each location in Aeon Drive references a real place, and even the backgrounds hide some references to what's really going on out there.
Here are some locations we were inspired by when creating the game. And if you want to see the rest — well, you just got to play the full game once it comes out on September 30th!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BH6ZnLS.gif[/img]
[i]La Rambla street. Don’t you just want to jump all over those rooftops?[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZlnxNrZ.gif[/img]
[i]Park Guell. The original doesn’t come with deadly seesaws, though.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XUpexCP.gif[/img]
[i]The Eixample neighborhood in Barcelona. You can probably see where the game’s platforming roots came from.[/i]

Of course, Aeon Drive adds more cyberpunk and grit into the mix, and does take some liberties with its setting. Still, being settled in Barcelona during the development of the game, we took a lot of inspiration from our surroundings when working on the game’s pixel art. Not only that, but we made sure to include some specific references, which will probably only be clear to you if you spent some time in real Barcelona. We hope those of you familiar with the location appreciate our effort.

Add Aeon Drive to your Wishlist and get ready to see the rest of Neo Barcelona when the game releases on September 30th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252240/Aeon_Drive/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/4294d235e24333c1304b29792b51fdf560a0023a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Aeon Drive: Features
notes.notes:
Hey there speed demons! Today we'd like to highlight the features that make Aeon Drive stand out among the vast selection of platformer games out there.

[i]— Agility[/i]
Your running, jumping, falling, and wall-jumping speed all let you clear the stages in seconds if you know what you're doing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w40zZwT.gif[/img]

[i]— Movement options[/i]
Your trusty teleport dagger lets you cover huge distances in mere seconds. Moreover, Aeon Drive offers multiple ways to traverse your environment, and all of them let you keep your breakneck pace going!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d0roTVv.gif[/img]
Here is a taste of what you can do once you really get the hang of your dagger:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gTNx6nT.gif[/img]
And if all else fails, you can always rewind time and try again.

[i]— Multiplayer[/i]
What can be a better way to test your skills than competing with other players?
Get one to three friends and let the mayhem unfold!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nztIqpm.gif[/img]

The player who wins the most laps gets crowned 1st. Later stages even let you use traps to catch other players off guard! You can also play in co-op or compete via leaderboards. Both modes are playable locally and online.
Don’t let the world of Aeon Drive speed by you! The game releases in just 8 days so now is a great time to hop on-board.

The game releases on September 30th, so add it to your wishlist to keep an eye on it!
See you on the streets of Neo Barcelona!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/f5540622507d6c396ad891d6d06b8eeca2f9075a.png[/img]

[h3]Did you know Aeon Drive actually has a prequel game?
[/h3]

Go back to the origins of Aeon Drive’s universe with Dimension Drive, a mind-bending shoot-em-up which will have you hop between two dimensions in real time!

In Dimension Drive, the warmongering race of Ashajuls set its sights on the whole Universe, which triggered a full-scale war that left no one unscathed. However, even keeping most of the Universe under his thumb couldn't sate the hunger of the supreme leader Nies. Gadgets called Dimension Drives have then been invented to expand into other dimensions and fan the flames of a never-ending multi-dimensional war. As the last survivor of your race, it is your job to master dimension-hopping and put a stop to the bloodshed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/82156c651facdc7379600e4661f415daf124391b.gif[/img]

Blast your enemies, collect power-ups, and master hopping between two dimensions to keep yourself out of trouble. This old-school shoot-em-up with a new gameplay twist will test your body and mind and throw you into a battle of galactic proportions, which kickstarted the Drive universe!

[h3]While you’re waiting for Aeon Drive’s release, check out this prequel story for FREE from June 3 through June 7.[/h3]

notes.title: Aeon Drive in a nutshell
notes.notes:
Aeon Drive is a speedrun action platformer set in a Cyberpunk Barcelona. 

The player controls Jackelyne, a stranded space pilot on a quest to retrieve faulty pieces of dimension-bending machinery in order to preserve the space-time fabric of the universe. 

Jack will have to overcome a myriad obstacles using her sword, her teleportation dagger, and her unique skill to control time.

Aeon Drive´s alpha demo has the below key features:

- 11 levels across 4 different cities 
- Unique teleportation mechanic that encourages speedrun
- Eye-catching quality synthwave pixel art style.
- Real-time difficulty adjustment in the hands of the player : play as a Pro or casually stroll around the city.
- Discord, Twitter and leaderboard competition perfect for Streamers
- Strong replayability with levels designed to have multiple routes that can be discovered depending on player skill.
- Non-linear level design in collaboration with community speedrunners.
